description:
Installation of one domestic air-to-air heat pump (Daikin 5MXM90A9 or equivalent) under Class G permitted development rights.  
Works comprise: - Fixing one external compressor/condenser unit at ground level in the side passage between 32 and 34 Townshend Terrace, Richmond, TW9 1XL, as shown on the submitted site plan.  
- Drilling through the external wall to install refrigerant pipework, condensate drain and electrical cabling between the external unit and internal fan-coil units.  
- Installation of internal fan-coil unit(s) within the property, with associated pipework, cabling and controls.  
- Minor associated works including making good around penetrations, cable/pipework containment, and any small hardstanding or plinth required to support the external unit.  
No new access, street, means of enclosure or drainage of land is proposed. The external unit is sited as shown on the plans, with dimensions and clearances as per manufacturer and MCS 020a requirements.
